findings.title: Historical burn-rate forecast is presented as current
findings.what: The component labels the derived value as a "7-day burn rate" and says "On current burn you'll hit ... this month" even when the newest loaded entry is historical. Although lines 652-657 display the dataset range, the forecast itself is not demoted to an explicit "as of <lastDay>" statement, so stale uploads can be mistaken for a current-month forecast.
findings.fix: Qualify the burn rate and projection with costTrend.lastDay, for example "7-day burn rate as of <lastDay>" and "At the burn rate as of <lastDay>, projected <YYYY-MM> spend..."; avoid unqualified "current" and "this month."
findings.acceptance: Render TokenUsagePf with entries whose last timestamp is 2026-01-07 and assert that the forecast visibly says "as of 2026-01-07" (and identifies the projected month or otherwise avoids unqualified "this month/current burn").
findings.verifyNote: Adversarial re-read confirmed lines 648-670 use present-tense/current-month language for every nonempty dated series. The smallest related baseline calculation check confirmed the projection is anchored to the most recent observed data day rather than the wall-clock date, so an old upload reproducibly produces the misleading wording.
